name: Matia MCP
description:
Matia is the Unified DataOps Platform for data, AI, and engineering teams, combining ingestion, reverse ETL, observability, and catalog in one place. This MCP gives your agent a single interface to all of it.

Because Matia is one unified platform rather than a stack of point tools, the MCP can follow a problem across the entire data lifecycle in a single session. It answers where a number came from and what breaks if you change it, without stitching together separate tools for ingestion, observability, and activation.

Works alongside your warehouse MCP, such as Snowflake, so agents move from pipeline health to the underlying data in one flow. Requires a Matia account.

Better together. Do more with Matia.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Matia MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Matia MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.matia.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Matia MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matia MCP lists 15 MCP tools, including audit_log_search, explain, get_asset, get_lineage, get_monitor, list_connectors, list_integration_runs, list_issues, list_monitors, list_tags, preview_impact, and run_integration_action.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Matia MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Matia MCP in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Matia MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matia MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Matia MCP is developed by Matia. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
